## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Liú-Sòng translation by Huìjiǎn of a discourse about a householder's son who renounced and returned to lay life six times before finally settling in the saṅgha. The Chinese parallel is T125[35.10].

**Abstract**

T137 was produced by Huìjiǎn at the Lùyěsì in 457 CE (cf. [KR6a0043](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0043)); the date is recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost.
